hints.title: Left-to-Right Flip Choice
hints.text: The leftmost zero must be flipped, and flipping the size 3 window starting at that position is forced.

hints.title: Greedy Simulation
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 up to n - 3. If nums[i] == 0, flip nums[i], nums[i + 1], and nums[i + 2], incrementing operations.

hints.title: Suffix Verification
hints.text: After the loop, if either of the last two elements is 0, it is impossible to make all elements 1; return -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: In-place bit flips with single linear traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all possible flip subsets takes exponential O(2^n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that the leftmost zero determines a unique forced flip.
